gate_authority_note: A7 recommends passage only. Lead/A8 retains gate-signing authority.

authority_review.cambridge_qp_ms_atoms: All 406 atoms retain the source atom identity in locator.bullet_locator, an MS source/page locator, the paired QP source/page locator in anchor_text, and context-bound editorial-paraphrase language.
authority_review.caveats: All 91 RETAIN_WITH_SOURCE_CAVEAT atoms retain disposition, award semantics, group/dependency/source-issue context inside the criterion; each chain forbids adding atoms into a newly inferred mark total.
authority_review.practice_rubrics: All 18 self-rubrics declare AlgoCore_authored_rubric and official_marks=null.

pedagogy_review.theory_to_code: Every lesson resolves one or more KnowledgeUnits to its PythonArtifact.
pedagogy_review.code_to_trace: Every one of the 16 patterns resolves execution-backed normal, boundary and failure VisualScenarioTrace records.
pedagogy_review.trace_to_error_prevention: Every pattern resolves a MarkingChain with an error_ref, detection_check and repair_check.
pedagogy_review.error_prevention_to_practice: Every AssessmentItem joins prompt-proven patterns and requirement refs, canonical artifact/fixture/expected-output IDs, specific feedback, and a no-partial-pass self-rubric.
pedagogy_review.progression: Each lesson has exactly guided, faded and independent items. Guided uses normal evidence, faded uses boundary evidence, and independent requires normal/boundary/failure evidence.
pedagogy_review.expected_artifact_locale_parity: All 18 AssessmentItems carry strict, non-empty {vi,en} expected_artifact objects validated by the v2 schema and A7 checker.

findings.statement: Caveated QP/MS atoms remain context-bound; authors and learners must consult the cited paper and mark scheme rather than treating the combined chain as a fresh official mark allocation.
This review does not sign the release gate. Lead/A8 must independently verify current hashes and acceptance criteria.
